programmes.d: This reunion show features the five surviving members of Monty Python, with Graham Chapman in attendance in the form of his "ashes" being brought out in an urn. The Pythons look back at their work and receive an American Film Industry award.
The very best of John Cleese's Monty Python performances and sketches.

Conquistador coffee campaign; Repeating groove; Ramsey MacDonald striptease; Job hunter; International Chinese Communist Conspiracy; Crelm Toothpaste/Shrill petrol; Agatha Christie sketch (railway timetables).

World revolutionaries are quizzed about football scores; figures from works of art go on strike throughout galleries in England; the search continues for a cure for over-acting; Viking marauders kidnap Englishmen who ask for canned ham.
Fran returns from a vacation in Cornwall to discover Manny and Bernard in quite a state.
It's International Children's Book Week and Bernard and Manny decide to write their own kids' classic.

Camilla Duchess of Cornwall, Kate and Wills are away, it’s Camilla’s turn to look after Princes Charlotte for the day but Camilla is better with boys they just need food and exercise. Meanwhile, a top team from GCHQ are staking out a couple in a pub.
Tracey Ullman inhabits troubled artist Sharon Utley. They’ve opened a gallery in her name in her old home town, but who is Stick of Rock Man, and what really happened to the pier?
"The Attila the Hun Show"; a burlesque performance by government ministers; a documentary study of village idiots. Also: political groupies pursue MPs.
A dissatisfied bridegroom tries to exchange his spouse; hunters pursue a terrifying mosquito; domestic problems interrupt the work of Beethoven, Shakespeare, Michelangelo and other creative geniuses.

This documentary, featuring new interviews with the Pythons and home-movie glimpses of fledging Python-mania, follows the troupe's long and winding road to the States, acknowledging the unsung heroes in the Python story.

programmes.t: Monty Python Live (Mostly): One Down, Five To Go
programmes.d: Filmed on the final night of the run of ten sold out performances, live at London's O2 Arena, Monty Python Live (mostly) – One Down Five to Go sees the five surviving members together performing many of their classic sketches and much-loved songs.
